name: Chief Casmir Igbokwe
major: Chief Casmir Chibuzo Igbokwe, a former Editor of Sunday Punch , is an award-winning Nigerian journalist and media manager. Currently, He is the Publisher/Editor-in-Chief of NewsProbe online Newspaper. He is also a visiting member of the Editorial Boards of the Sun and The Punch newspapers. Born at Isuofia in Aguata Local Government Area of Anambra State on September 6, 1968, Igbokwe started his primary school education at Central Urban School, Abakaliki in Ebonyi State in 1975. He later moved to his home town in 1978 to complete his primary education at Central School, Isuofia, in 1981. He had his secondary education at Uga Boys Secondary School, Uga in Aguata Local Government Area of Anambra State from 1981 to 1986. Igbokwe has a Bachelor’s degree in Dramatic Arts from the University of Nigeria, Nsukka (1992) and Master’s in International Journalism from Cardiff University in the United Kingdom (2007). He was a Chevening scholar and has also attended some professional training and workshop both in Nigeria and abroad. They include, among others, BBC World Service workshop on political reporting (25-29 January, 1999); Independent Journalism Centre/Friedrich Ebert Foundation workshop on reporting democratic institutions (25-27 July, 2000); Media-For-Democracy Project seminar on media and conflict reporting/management (26-28 September, 2000); British Council/Cardiff University international colloquium on role of journalists in facilitating pluralist democracy in multi-cultural societies (04-11 July 2005). Igbokwe started his full-time journalism career in 1997 with the Independent Communications Network Limited, publishers of TheNews/Tempo magazines as well as PM News. He was the Port Harcourt Correspondent. While in Port Harcourt, he distinguished himself as a fine writer and investigative reporter. In less than three years, he was promoted to senior correspondent. Igbokwe joined The Punch newspaper in August 2003 and endeared himself to the management of the newspaper through his works. For years, he maintained a back page opinion column in The Punch called Musing. For many of his fans, Musing was like a bible which must be read religiously. He left The Punch as a senior member of the editorial board to become the pioneer daily editor of Hallmark newspaper in 2013. He was to become the pioneer daily editor of The Union newspaper in 2014 and eventually rose to become the paper’s Editor-in-Chief in January 2015. He left The Union in 2017 to establish an online newspaper called NewsProbe. Igbokwe is a well-known fearless and erudite writer who laces his articles with humour and leaves you nodding your head after reading them. For years, he maintained a back page column in The Punch called Musing. For many of his fans, Musing was like a bible which must be read religiously. He currently maintains a full page weekly column for The Sun, one of Nigeria’s leading newspapers. An amiable and humble gentleman, Igbokwe is widely travelled. He is married to Ifeoma Stella Igbokwe and has three children. Igbokwe is also a union and community leader and currently a member, Nigerian Guild of Editors. He is also a member of the Monitoring and Evaluation Committee (M$E) of the National Anti-Corruption Strategy (NACS), a program of the Federal Government of Nigeria. He is the Chairman of the Board of Cyril and Susanna Foundation.

name: Dr. Okwudili Celestine Ezeabasili Ph.D (Lagos); M.Sc; MBA; BA (Hons)
major: Dr. Okwudili Celestine Ezeabasili is an academic, researcher, publisher, and scholar; and a member of the Board of the Cyril and Susanna Foundation, Isuofia. A multifaceted intellectual, Dr Okwudili is deeply engaged in the world of knowledge creation, dissemination, and critical inquiry. He is driven by a passion for understanding complex issues and contributing meaningfully to the field of social sciences, public administration, and e-Learning. His works transcend the boundaries of a single role, as he seamlessly integrates teaching, research and profound learning. As an academic, He is dedicated to the pursuit and transmission of knowledge within a higher education setting; the University of Lagos, Nigeria. This involves teaching and mentoring, fostering critical thinking, and guiding the next generation of scholars. He has also participated in the governance and development of his academic institution through the Quality Assurance Committee, and other service roles such as graduate project supervisor, academic adviser, and e-Tutor. Driven by intellectual curiosity, He is actively engaged in systematic inquiry to generate new knowledge or refine existing understanding through identifying significant gaps in knowledge and developing focused research agendas, and analytical frameworks. As a publisher, Dr. Okwudili has contributed to the dissemination of scholarly work through various channels. This involves authoring several textbooks in the field of Political Science, Public Administration, Intergovernmental Relations, and over ten scholarly articles in reputable journals; sharing his research findings and insights with the academic community and wider audience through peer-reviewed publications. He is actively reviewing manuscripts to provide critical and constructive feedback on the work of other scholars, thereby upholding the standards of academic rigor. Underpinning all these roles is a deep commitment to lifelong learning, intellectual integrity, and the pursuit of wisdom. This is characterized by critical thinking and analysis, approaching information with a discerning mind, evaluating evidence rigorously, and forming independent judgments; adhering to the highest ethical standards in research, teaching, and publication, as well as, participating in conferences, seminars, and scholarly discussions to exchange ideas and advance knowledge. In this way, he demonstrates unwavering commitment to sharing his expertise and insight with the broader public to inform and enrich societal understanding. In essence, Dr Okwudili Celestine Ezeabasili is a vital contributor to the intellectual ecosystem, playing a crucial role in the creation, validation, and dissemination of knowledge; ultimately enriching our understanding of the world and shaping future generations of learners and thinkers. Born into the royal Ezeabasili Dynasty in Ozala Isuofia, Aguata Local Council Area, Dr. Okwudili Ezeabasili holds the traditional chieftancy title of Ozo Ezeifezue. A community leader, Patron of the Nigeria Red Cross, Patron of the Catholic Women Organization, and devout Christian; He is a member of numerous pious societies such as the Catholic Men Organization, Sacred Heart of Jesus and Immaculate Heart of Mary, the Justice Development and Peace Commission, and the Serra International, District 130-C Nigeria. He is peacefully married to Lolo Chinenye Maureen, and their union is blessed with good children.

name: Mr Oliver Nwankwo B.Phil, PGDM, MBA
major: Mr Oliver Nnamdi Nwankwor is an astute entrepreneur and an international  businessman. Currently, He is a promoter and  distributor of a leading name in household Electronics, Djack and ICT materials. Born at Isuofia in Aguata Local Government Area of Anambra State on August 19th, 1979, Oliver started his primary school education at Ikemee Primary School Isuofia and Central School Isuofia, Aguata Local Government, Anambra in 1984 and completed in 1990. He had his junior secondary education at St.Dominic Savio Seminary, Akpu in Orumba Local Government Area of Anambra State from 1990 to 1993 and his Senior Secondary School at St Johnbosco Seminary Isuaniocha in Awka North Local Government Area of Anambra State from 1993 to 1995. Oliver had a Bachelor’s degree in Philosophy from Bigard Memorial Seminary, Enugu, an affliate of Pontifical Urbaniana University Rome (2001) and Post graduate diploma in Management and  Master’s in Business Administration from University of Calabar, 2005 and 2007 respectively. Oliver is a member of Nigeria Institute of Management, Chartered. A member of Computers and Electronics dealers Association in Calabar, Cross River state and Uyo in Akwa Ibom state. Oliver registered his business enterprise with corporate affairs commission as Olivite Impression ventures  in 2007. A household name in office consumables and electronics. A name that has maintained quality and trust for years in business. Oliver is a pacesetter and humble gentleman who has travelled far and wide in search of business opportunities. He is married to Adaobi Chimaoge Nwankwor and has three children. Oliver is also a Christian, a union leader and motivator who holds many positions in church and society. He is the Secretary/accountant of the Board of Cyril and Susanna Foundation.

name: Mr Paschal Obinna Ofojeama BSc. PGDE. BA.
major: Mr Paschal Obinna Ofojeama BSc. PGDE. BA. was born on the 6th day of April 1980. He attended Ikemee Primary School Isuofia and obtained his First School Leaving Certificate in 1992. He equally attended Community Secondary School Isuofia in 1993. In 1994 he gained admission into St Dominic Savio Seminary Akpu in Orumba South L.G.A  In continuation of his secondary education, he proceeded to St John Bosco Seminary Isuaniocha, in Awka North LGA where he obtained his Senior School Certificate in Education in the year 2000. In 2004, he gained admission into Nnamdi Azikiwe University Awka from where he obtained his BSc in Botany. In 2016 he obtained his Post Graduate Diploma in Education from National Open University. He equally obtained BA. in French from the department of Modern and European Languages in Nnamdi Azikiwe University Awka in 2022. Mr Paschal Ofojeama is a civil servant. Currently he is the secretary to the MD/CEO of TRACAS. Mr Paschal is also a renowned crop farmer known for production of rice, cassava and yam.

name: Ms Ekwy Nwife

She is a dedicated educator with number of years of experience, teaching Economics/ Business Studies at Holy Child Secondary School Isuofia Aguata, Anambra Nigeria. She brings real world experience into the classroom to help students connect theory to practicals. She is committed to helping the students achieve their full potential and develop a lifelong love of learning. As a teacher with a passion, she developes innovative and teaching methods to engage students and promote academic excellence. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION She Obtained her National Certificate in Education under the department of Accounting Education at Federal College Of Education Technical Umunze Orumba South L.G.A,   Anambra State Nigeria and her B.SC in Economics in Enugu State Science and Technology Enugu State Nigeria. While her M. SC in Statistics is still in progress. ABUBA UGO Or OMUGA'' She is currently a seasoned teacher in Holychild Secondary School Isuofia. A member of sacred Heart of Jesus, and one of the Animators of the Holychild Hood of St Patrick's, CADEK/ ISUOFIA Deanery.
